evidence.name: Screen field: Thickness of the outline
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Thickness of the outline" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Thickness of the outline
sections.description: Controls how thick the field's outline is, from 0 to 50 pixels (default 1). Keep it at 1-2 pixels for a clean, modern look and only go thicker for a deliberately bold style. A visible but restrained outline helps people spot the field at a glance and answer faster.
